text: Keep an eye out for hidden quests.
You can show or hide helmets in Settings.
Press the Call key to Quick Save.
You must save at least once before using the Cash Shop.
Search every corner of the map for hidden treasure chests.
Monsters lower level than you may grant no EXP.
Sub-quests can be abandoned by pressing * in the Quest log.
Most special monster attacks deal magic damage.
You cannot dash while under movement speed debuffs.
Only basic attacks can be used while frozen.
Spirit skill 'Full Immunity' cleanses all status ailments.
Spirit skill 'Wings' cleanses slow movement effects.
Monsters with red names are elite and dangerous. Beware!
If game runs slow, reduce visual effects in Settings.
Socket equipment can be acquired from crafting or monster drops.
You can craft and fuse items in Skill > General menu.
Standing still recovers HP and SP rapidly.
Heroes Lore 5 features multiple story endings.
Different blacksmiths can craft different items.
Heavy single hits are more effective than rapid hits against high DEF foes.
Crafting materials can be gathered from breakable bushes and rocks.
Skills like Bombardment and Rapid Fire can be cancelled by pressing skill again.
Specializing skills can increase range and attack speed.
Quest hints may be hidden in dialogues with NPCs.
Relic boxes can yield gear with reduced level requirements.
Quest items from uncompleted sub-quests can be sold to merchants.
